verses.text: [“]Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, who have descended from the line of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD, who invoke the God of Israel— but not in truth or righteousness—

xrefs.text: and if you can swear, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness, then the nations will be blessed by Him, and in Him they will glory.”
Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.
Fear the LORD your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.
Although they say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ they are swearing falsely.”
Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known,

verses.text: who indeed call yourselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel; the LORD of Hosts is His name.

xrefs.text: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money. Yet they lean upon the LORD, saying, “Is not the LORD among us? No disaster can come upon us.”
On that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer depend on him who struck them, but they will truly rely on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
Awake, awake, clothe yourself with strength, O Zion! Put on your garments of splendor, O Jerusalem, holy city! For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer enter you.
Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;

“Please inquire of the LORD on our behalf, since Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is waging war against us. Perhaps the LORD will perform for us something like all His past wonders, so that Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw from us.”

verses.text: I foretold the former things long ago; they came out of My mouth and I proclaimed them. Suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.

xrefs.text: Behold, the former things have happened, and now I declare new things. Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you.”
“Let them come and tell us what will happen. Tell the former things, so that we may reflect on them and know the outcome. Or announce to us what is coming.
Not one of all the LORD’s good promises to the house of Israel had failed; everything was fulfilled.

Speak up and present your case— yes, let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago? Who announced it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me.
Who then is like Me? Let him say so! Let him declare his case before Me, since I established an ancient people. Let him foretell the things to come, and what is to take place.

verses.text: For I knew that you are stubborn; your neck is iron and your forehead is bronze.

xrefs.text: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did.
The LORD also said to Moses, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder; they stopped up their ears from hearing.
A man who remains stiff-necked after much reproof will suddenly be shattered beyond recovery.
Then He said to me, “Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak My words to them.

verses.text: Therefore I declared it to you long ago; I announced it before it came to pass, so that you could not claim, ‘My idol has done this; my carved image and molten god has ordained it.’

xrefs.text: I foretold the former things long ago; they came out of My mouth and I proclaimed them. Suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.

Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, and all the women standing by— a great assembly— along with all the people living in the land of Egypt and in Pathros, said to Jeremiah,
that have been known for ages.’
I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.

verses.text: You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not acknowledge them? From now on I will tell you of new things, hidden things unknown to you.

xrefs.text: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.
Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery concealed for ages past
Behold, the former things have happened, and now I declare new things. Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you.”
Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.

verses.text: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot claim, ‘I already knew them!’
You have never heard; you have never understood; for a long time your ears have not been open. For I knew how deceitful you are; you have been called a rebel from birth.

xrefs.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.
They have been unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon will devour them along with their land.
and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: Your origin and your birth were in the land of the Canaanites. Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like the messenger I am sending? Who is blind like My covenant partner, or blind like the servant of the LORD?
This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’

verses.text: For the sake of My name I will delay My wrath; for the sake of My praise I will restrain it, so that you will not be cut off.

xrefs.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
‘I will defend this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David.’”
And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.
Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.

verses.text: See, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.

xrefs.text: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, but the LORD is the tester of hearts.
Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.
For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.

verses.text: For My own sake, My very own sake, I will act; for how can I let Myself be defamed? I will not yield My glory to another.

xrefs.text: I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.

But I acted for the sake of My name, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they were living, in whose sight I had revealed Myself to Israel by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
‘I will defend this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David.’”
I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.

verses.text: Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I have called: I am He; I am the first, and I am the last.

xrefs.text: Who has performed this and carried it out, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD— the first and the last— I am He.”
“I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come— the Almighty.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.

verses.text: Surely My own hand founded the earth, and My right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they stand up together.

xrefs.text: And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.

For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens— He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am the LORD, and there is no other.
Lift up your eyes on high: Who created all these? He leads forth the starry host by number; He calls each one by name. Because of His great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing.

verses.text: Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The LORD’s chosen ally will carry out His desire against Babylon, and His arm will be against the Chaldeans.

xrefs.text: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this, and proclaim to us the former things? Let them present their witnesses to vindicate them, so that others may hear and say, “It is true.”
Behold, I will stir up against them the Medes, who have no regard for silver and no desire for gold.
Go up against the land of Merathaim, and against the residents of Pekod. Kill them and devote them to destruction. Do all that I have commanded you,” declares the LORD.
Listen, a tumult on the mountains, like that of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms, like nations gathered together! The LORD of Hosts is mobilizing an army for war.
Come, gather together, and draw near, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry idols of wood and pray to a god that cannot save.

verses.text: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I have brought him, and he will succeed in his mission.

xrefs.text: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
This is what the LORD says to Cyrus His anointed, whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations before him, to disarm kings, to open the doors before him, so that the gates will not be shut:
In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
On the fifth day of the month— it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—

verses.text: Come near to Me and listen to this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time it happened, I was there.” And now the Lord GOD has sent me, accompanied by His Spirit.

xrefs.text: “I have spoken openly to the world, Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.
I have not spoken in secret, from a place in a land of darkness. I did not say to the descendants of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in a wasteland.’ I, the LORD, speak the truth; I say what is right.

The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,
For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.

verses.text: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who directs you in the way you should go.

xrefs.text: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
Reconcile now and be at peace with Him; thereby good will come to you.
You might say in your heart, “The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.”
The Lord will give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, but your Teacher will no longer hide Himself— with your own eyes you will see Him.

verses.text: If only you had paid attention to My commandments, your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like waves of the sea.

xrefs.text: If only they had such a heart to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their children forever.
Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
For this is what the LORD says: “I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flowing stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm, and bounced upon her knees.
If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,
If only they were wise, they would understand it; they would comprehend their fate.

verses.text: Your descendants would have been as countless as the sand, and your offspring as numerous as its grains; their name would never be cut off or eliminated from My presence.”

xrefs.text: Though your people, O Israel, be like the sand of the sea, only a remnant will return. Destruction has been decreed, overflowing with righteousness.
I will surely bless you, and I will multiply your descendants like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will possess the gates of their enemies.
As the hosts of heaven cannot be counted and as the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, so too will I multiply the descendants of My servant David and the Levites who minister before Me.”
Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: “Though the number of the Israelites is like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.

Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. And it will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

verses.text: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! Declare it with a shout of joy, proclaim it, let it go out to the ends of the earth, saying, “The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob!”

xrefs.text: Flee from the midst of Babylon; depart from the land of the Chaldeans; be like the he-goats that lead the flock.
Break forth in joy, sing together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.
Come out of her, My people! Save your lives, each of you, from the fierce anger of the LORD.
Flee from Babylon! Escape with your lives! Do not be destroyed in her punishment. For this is the time of the LORD’s vengeance; He will pay her what she deserves.
Then I heard another voice from heaven say: “Come out of her, My people, so that you will not share in her sins or contract any of her plagues.

verses.text: They did not thirst when He led them through the deserts; He made water flow for them from the rock; He split the rock, and water gushed out.

xrefs.text: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
The poor and needy seek water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
Then the lame will leap like a deer and the mute tongue will shout for joy. For waters will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.” So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.

verses.text: “There is no peace,” says the LORD, “for the wicked.”

xrefs.text: “There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”
A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.
